parameters.content:
## Watch Amazon Electronics deals

### How it works
Run manually to collect Amazon US Electronics deals with [FalconScrape's Amazon Today's Deals Scraper](https://apify.com/piotrv1001/amazon-todays-deals-scraper). The Actor filters for at least 25% off, and this workflow keeps a capped, replay-safe record in Google Sheets.

The workflow checks your destination, creates and locks three managed tabs, then starts one bounded Apify run or resumes its saved run ID. It validates ASINs and product links before writing. **Amazon Deals Current** keeps the latest observation for each ASIN; **Amazon Deals History** records each run; **Amazon Deals Runs** holds the recovery ID and import status. The first import is a baseline. NEW means newly observed in this spreadsheet, not newly listed by Amazon. Missing deals are not declared expired. Prices are displayed deal prices; verify shipping, taxes, coupons, and eligibility on Amazon.

### Setup
1. Install the official Apify integration. Select **Apify API** credentials on Apify requests and **Google Sheets OAuth2** on Sheets requests.
2. Create an empty spreadsheet and paste its ID into **Configure search**. Keep **amazon.com**; the US Electronics collection is fixed in this edition.
3. Leave **resumeRunId** blank, keep **20 deals** and the **$0.10** charge ceiling, then execute. The template is free; Actor use and n8n hosting may incur charges.
4. On interruption, inspect **Amazon Deals Runs** and Apify. Once no execution is active, remove the temporary lock tab and resume the saved run. Stopping n8n does not stop Apify.

### Customization
Archive managed tabs before 5,000 rows; keep personal columns beyond the managed range.

## 1. Set up Amazon US
Keep amazon.com and enter an empty spreadsheet ID. This edition watches the US Electronics collection, starting with 20 deals and a $0.10 Actor charge ceiling.

## 2. Prepare three managed tabs
The workflow creates Current, History, and Runs tabs, then locks the spreadsheet against overlapping writes. It validates existing headers before starting paid work.

## 3. Start or resume safely
Leave resumeRunId blank for one bounded, 25%-off Electronics scrape. To recover, enter the saved run ID. Its original domain, filters, and item limit must match.

## 4. Checkpoint and wait
The Actor run ID is saved before polling. Only a successful, bounded dataset is imported. If waiting stops, inspect Apify and resume the same run instead of starting another.

## 5. Record deal observations
Deals are keyed by ASIN. The first import is a baseline; unseen ASINs on later imports are NEW to this spreadsheet. Each observed deal gets a per-run history row.

## 6. Unlock and review
Current deals, history, and the run log are written together. The temporary lock is removed last. Review rejected-row counts before relying on the sheet.
